29th July 2026

TIL

Adding a custom MCP server to Claude and ChatGPT— I've started exploring [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) in more detail. The web chat UIs for both Claude and ChatGPT can access MCP servers but it's not obvious how to set them up. Here's what I figured out.

Connecting a custom MCP server to Claude and ChatGPT's standard chat interfaces is possible, but can take quite a few steps.
